_comment: Schedules of cluster periodic tasks, shared by every implementation.
constants: the acquire window, the minimum hold, the lease bounds, the cluster interval floor, the task name and scope patterns (matched as whole strings) and the system task names.
messages: the validation texts; {x} is a placeholder. The prefix_* entries go before a rule_* text.

cron_cases: the cron subset check. accepted: true carries start and the next five fire times, each strictly after the one before (UTC). accepted: false carries the message of the first refusal: the syntax check in its order, then one fire-time lookup (cron_never).
interval_slots: the first slot strictly after now; slots are whole multiples of the interval since the epoch. now is truncated to the whole second first.
cron_slots: the first fire time strictly after now truncated to the whole second.
scopes: the election scope of a task: the sanitized cluster, a slash, the task name.
scope_checks: valid scopes split back into cluster and task; invalid ones are refused with the scope_invalid message.

hashes: definitions are objects with name, lease_seconds and exactly one of interval and cron. bytes: the JSON array sorted by name, sorted keys, no spaces, raw UTF-8. hash: the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of bytes.

messages.rule_name: the name must be 1 to 64 characters of a-z, 0-9 and _, and must not start with a digit
messages.rule_scope: scope must be worker or cluster
messages.rule_one_schedule: give exactly one of interval and cron
messages.rule_cluster_interval: a cluster task's interval must be a whole number of seconds and at least 30
messages.rule_lease_scope: lease_seconds is only for cluster tasks
messages.rule_lease_bounds: lease_seconds must be a whole number from 40 to 86400
messages.rule_at_most_one: give at most one of interval and cron
messages.rule_archive_interval: interval must be a whole number of seconds and at least 30
messages.rule_dot_name: a name with a dot is a system task; configure it in its own section (cache.*, history.archive)
messages.rule_unknown_task: the handler declares no periodic task of that name
messages.override_null: periodic.tasks.{name} has no value; write {} to keep the declared settings
messages.startup_no_shared_folder: periodic task '{name}' has scope cluster, but the filesystem election needs a shared folder (shared.dir or storage.dir)
messages.cron_fields: cron '{expr}' must have 5 fields separated by single spaces
messages.cron_day_rule: cron '{expr}' restricts both the day of month and the day of week; make one of them *
messages.cron_element: cron '{expr}': {field} element '{item}' is not one of *, */s, v, a-b, a-b/s
messages.cron_value: cron '{expr}': {field} value '{token}' is not one of {allowed}
messages.cron_range: cron '{expr}': {field} range '{item}' must go from a lower to a higher value
messages.cron_step: cron '{expr}': {field} step '{step}' must be from 1 to {max_step}

cron '5-5/2 * * * *': minute range '5-5/2' must go from a lower to a higher value
cron '1/2 * * * *': minute element '1/2' is not one of *, */s, v, a-b, a-b/s
cron '0 0 1 * 1' restricts both the day of month and the day of week; make one of them *
cron '@hourly' must have 5 fields separated by single spaces
cron '0 0 L * *': day of month element 'L' is not one of *, */s, v, a-b, a-b/s
cron '1-99 * * * *': minute value '99' is not one of 0-59
cron '0 0 * foo *': month value 'foo' is not one of 1-12 or JAN-DEC
cron 'abc * * * *': minute value 'abc' is not one of 0-59
